label: Floating Data Pills
description: Data made physical: small labeled chips drifting in faux-3D around a hero stat or headline (the '+340 h' orbit move). Place its box over the region containing the hero (e.g. the full stage over a number-counter scene) at a HIGH z_index; pills scatter in a ring around the center, entrance-staggered, drifting continuously. 4-7 items max.
